# Physio Dynamics — Physiotherapy & Sports Rehabilitation Centre

> Physio Dynamics is Wayanad's leading physiotherapy and sports rehabilitation clinic, located in Panamaram, Kerala, India. Founded in August 2024 by BPT-qualified physiotherapist Sandra Thomas, we provide evidence-based, personalised physiotherapy across Wayanad including Panamaram, Mananthavady, Kalpetta, and Sulthan Bathery.

## Business Information

- **Name**: Physio Dynamics (Physiotherapy & Sports Rehabilitation Centre)

## Services Offered in Wayanad

- [Orthopedic Physiotherapy](https://www.physio-dynamics.com/service/orthopedic-physiotherapy) — treatment for bones, joints, muscles, post-surgical rehab, back pain, neck pain, arthritis
- [Neurological Physiotherapy](https://www.physio-dynamics.com/service/neurological-physiotherapy) — stroke rehabilitation, Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injuries, MS, mobility restoration
- [Sports Physiotherapy](https://www.physio-dynamics.com/service/sports-physiotherapy) — ACL rehab, sports injury treatment, performance enhancement, return-to-sport programs
- [Pediatric Physiotherapy](https://www.physio-dynamics.com/service/pediatric-physiotherapy) — developmental delays, cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, play-based therapy for children
- [Chest Physiotherapy](https://www.physio-dynamics.com/service/chest-physiotherapy) — COPD, asthma, bronchitis, post-COVID respiratory rehabilitation, pulmonary care
- [Home Care Physiotherapy](https://www.physio-dynamics.com/service/home-care) — mobile physiotherapy for elderly, post-surgical, and mobility-limited patients across Wayanad

## Areas Served

Panamaram, Mananthavady, Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, Vythiri, Ambalavayal, Thirunelly — all within Wayanad district, Kerala, India.

## About the Founder

Sandra Thomas is a BPT-qualified, HCPC (UK) registered physiotherapist with a FIFA Diploma in Football Medicine and the founder of Physio Dynamics. She specialises in orthopedic, sports, and neurological rehabilitation and is committed to delivering evidence-based, patient-centred care to the community of Wayanad.
- [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sandrathomas10/)
